survivorship_disclaimer:
SURVIVORSHIP BIAS DISCLOSURE:
This dataset utilizes current constituents of the NSE Nifty index. Backtesting current
index members historically introduces survivorship bias, as companies that were removed,
delisted, or went bankrupt during the backtest window are not included in the sample.
This structural bias tends to inflate historical performance metrics. For institutional
production deployment, point-in-time constituent lists (e.g., from NSE India official
historical archives or Bloomberg/Refinitiv) must be integrated.
